description: File-level and hunk-level disposition of every Gap-3 commit inherited into the CourtLens integration branch. Emitted per the CourtLens directive: 'Do not cherry-pick mixed commits wholesale. Create clean product-only commits.'

classifications.product-runtime: Runtime source that ships with the CourtLens product surface.
classifications.product-test: Unit / integration / e2e test that ships alongside product code.
classifications.shared-audit: Shared audit doctrine code consumed by CourtLens and other tenants.
classifications.schema-migration: SQL migration or generated schema snapshot required by product runtime.
classifications.test-infra: Reusable test infrastructure (e.g. Playwright / Vitest runner config).
classifications.proof-only: Ad-hoc fixture / smoke script used only for closure evidence.
classifications.unrelated: Change that touches a different product surface and must NOT ride on this branch.

excludedCommits.reason: Repairs pre-existing test failures in union-eyes and sage-core that are unrelated to CourtLens Gap 3. Moving these onto a CourtLens branch would contaminate the CourtLens diff and mask the true differential when we later revalidate the workspace. Belongs on its own product/test-hardening branch.
